title: Russia's Federal Security Service claims it uncovered a large-scale spyware operation by "foreign intelligence operatives" on senior officials' mobile phones (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Russia's Federal Security Service claims it uncovered a large-scale spyware operation by “foreign intelligence operatives” on senior officials' mobile phones — Russia's Federal Security Service said it uncovered a large-scale operation by foreign intelligence agencies to implant spyware on senior officials' mobile phones.
